purpose: Validators a worker may run through the broker as registered_validator actions. broker.register refuses a registered_validator whose id is absent here. Each row names its module and function; roles lists the cards that may run it in addition to the checks named on their own card.

validators.description: Dispatcher of the broker action `check run`: runs one row of this allowlist by check_id over workspace files and writes the check result as a pinned output.
Recompute the expected yield sigma x BR x L x K x efficiency from pinned inputs and compare it with the reported yield.
Run the computed items of the routine review checklist over a specification and its encoding.
Detect an acceptance criterion that contradicts the specification's declared bounds.
Apply the protected-path do-not-learn rule to a proposed lesson.
Compare a manuscript with the stored record: benchmark funnel, held-out exposure, pre-registered metric, selection timing and funnel disclosure.
Apply a review rubric, with the run's pinned overlay when one is selected, to the review packet an analysis declares.
Compare two independent implementations of one specification region by region.
Input closure of a pinned run (card-named check).
Deviation ledger closure (card-named check).
Certificate validation (card-named check).
Normalization ledger recomputation (card-named check).
Tiered cutflow certification (card-named check).
Route consistency of a run's detector and statistics modes (card-named check).
Trap-sweep record of a run (card-named check).
Task contract validation (card-named check).
Calibration checks named by the detector-calibrator card.
No agreement-reference or held-out artifact feeds the calibration (run check; check_inputs: spec).
Calibration and held-out confirmation partitions are both present and disjoint (run check; check_inputs: spec).
Every knob band equals its sourced anchor; candidates outside it stay inconclusive until R3 authority (run check; check_inputs: spec).
An imported calibration names its registered source and response and was not fitted on held-out nodes (run check; check_inputs: spec).
The calibration spec declares response knobs only; a global signal scalar or undeclared field is refused (run check; check_inputs: spec).
A registered signal-model completeness result precedes calibration; a scoped approximation is inconclusive until authorized (run check; check_inputs: spec).
The registered calibration receipt carries before and after scores and held-out scores (run check; check_inputs: receipt stage-output pin).
The registered calibration receipt carries the frozen response and every trial (run check; check_inputs: receipt stage-output pin).

Static UFO check of a model (parses, never imports): Mathematica leftovers, duplicate PDG codes, massless-with-width, required couplings and, with a spec, field charge and spin (document check; doc: files {name.py: source text}, spec ModelSpec or null).
Exact charge, hypercharge and colour-triality neutrality of every Lagrangian term of a ModelSpec (document check; doc: the ModelSpec, or {spec}).

Two-gauge FeynRules verdicts: unitary gauge decides and Feynman-gauge Goldstone mixing is waived only when reported (document check; doc: the {feynman, unitary, goldstones} record, a native receipt carrying it as gauge_checks, or {native, extra_goldstones}).

Every uncontrolled assumption at or above the severity floor appears in the delivered result (document check; doc: {audit: assumption-audit record, result: delivered result with assumptions_reported}).

Acceptance-times-efficiency certification ladder recomputed from the per-region rows and effective tolerances of its report; a stored verdict never grants the pass, a diagnostic report or a WARN is inconclusive (document check; doc: the certify_acceptance report).
The declared figure_spec (ranges, scales, aspect, binning, labels) is well formed; the live-figure layout gate runs inside the renderer and is not re-run (document check; doc: {figure_spec}).

Declared figure files exist on disk, are captioned and meet the declared figure contract in the run's figures.json; an open caption or contract target is inconclusive (run check; reads the run tree, optional check_inputs: figures path).
Declared figure targets carry generated counterparts once generation has run (run check; reads inputs/task_contract.json and inputs/figure_target.json of the run).
inputs/resource_census.json exists and records at least one resource rung (run check; reads inputs/task_contract.json and the census of the run).
